text: RESULT v1 | kb84b77644d | Cloudflare Workers static-site caching uses: (1) the Cloudflare CDN edge cache, readable/writable from a Worker via the Cache API (caches.default, cache.match(), cache.put()); (2) Workers KV or bundled Static Assets served at the edge, typically fronted by the CDN cache. Example duration: Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400 (86400 seconds). Mandatory preflight validation sequence: (1) define an explicit success condition, e.g. "GET /index.html returns 200 with cf-cache-status HIT on second request"; (2) validate the rule against that condition using wrangler dev or a preview deployment, checking headers and cache behavior; (3) confirm results match the condition and scope only intended routes, then deploy with wrangler deploy and re-verify the same condition in production.
